```{r}
library(MCMCpack)
library(compositions)
library(limma)

## -----------------------------
## 1. Simulator
## -----------------------------
simulate_topics_dirichlet <- function(
  N = 1000,
  G = 500,
  K = 5,
  frac_diff = 0.4,
  beta_strength = 2,
  seed = 123
) {
  set.seed(seed)

  X <- rbinom(N, 1, 0.5)

  mu_k   <- rnorm(K, 0, 1)
  diff_k <- sample(c(TRUE, FALSE), K, replace = TRUE,
                   prob = c(frac_diff, 1 - frac_diff))
  beta_k <- ifelse(diff_k, rnorm(K, mean = beta_strength, sd = 2), 0)

  eta <- sapply(seq_len(K), function(k) {
    rnorm(N, mean = mu_k[k] + X * beta_k[k], sd = 1)
  })

  softmax <- function(v) exp(v) / sum(exp(v))
  Z <- t(apply(eta, 1, softmax))
  stopifnot(all(abs(rowSums(Z) - 1) < 1e-8))

  T_mat <- matrix(rlnorm(K * G, meanlog = 0, sdlog = 1), K, G)
  W <- t(apply(T_mat, 1, function(a) MCMCpack::rdirichlet(1, a)))
  rownames(W) <- paste0("Topic", seq_len(K))

  l_n <- runif(N, 1000, 10000)
  alpha_g <- rexp(G, rate = 0.2)

  mean_ng <- (Z %*% W) * l_n

  X_ng <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = N, ncol = G)
  for (g in seq_len(G)) {
    shape <- alpha_g[g]
    rate  <- alpha_g[g] / mean_ng[, g]
    X_ng[, g] <- rgamma(N, shape = shape, rate = rate)
  }

  Y_ng <- matrix(rpois(N * G, lambda = as.vector(X_ng)), N, G)

  list(
    Y = Y_ng,
    Z = Z,
    W = W,
    beta_true = beta_k,
    diff_topics = diff_k,
    diff_topic_ids = which(diff_k),
    X = X,
    mu = mu_k,
    alpha_g = alpha_g,
    library_size = l_n
  )
}

## -----------------------------
## 2. Metrics
## -----------------------------
compute_metrics <- function(disc, true_topics) {
  power <- if (any(true_topics)) mean(disc[true_topics]) else NA_real_
  n_disc <- sum(disc)
  emp_fdr <- if (n_disc == 0) 0 else sum(disc & !true_topics) / n_disc
  list(power = power, emp_fdr = emp_fdr)
}

## -----------------------------
## 3. Pseudo-count computation
## -----------------------------
compute_mnk <- function(Z, Y, W, eps = 1e-8) {
  N <- nrow(Z)
  K <- ncol(Z)
  mnk <- matrix(0, N, K)

  for (n in seq_len(N)) {
    denom <- drop(Z[n, , drop = FALSE] %*% W) + eps
    for (k in seq_len(K)) {
      w <- Z[n, k] * W[k, ] / denom
      mnk[n, k] <- sum(Y[n, ] * w)
    }
  }

  colnames(mnk) <- paste0("Topic", seq_len(K))
  mnk
}

## -----------------------------
## 4. One-run quasi-Poisson method
## -----------------------------
run_one_sim_poisson <- function(
  N = 1000,
  G = 300,
  K = 6,
  frac_diff = 0.4,
  beta_strength = 2,
  seed = 1
) {
  sim <- simulate_topics_dirichlet(
    N = N,
    G = G,
    K = K,
    frac_diff = frac_diff,
    beta_strength = beta_strength,
    seed = seed
  )

  Z <- as.matrix(sim$Z)
  Y <- as.matrix(sim$Y)
  W <- as.matrix(sim$W)
  X_cond <- sim$X
  true_topics <- sim$diff_topics
  size_factor <- as.numeric(sim$library_size)

  mnk <- compute_mnk(Z, Y, W)

  pvals <- numeric(K)
  for (k in seq_len(K)) {
    fit <- suppressWarnings(
      glm(mnk[, k] ~ X_cond + offset(log(size_factor)),
          family = quasipoisson())
    )
    pvals[k] <- summary(fit)$coefficients["X_cond", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  }

  adj_pvals <- p.adjust(pvals, method = "fdr")
  disc <- adj_pvals < 0.05

  list(
    disc = disc,
    true_topics = true_topics,
    pvals = pvals,
    adj_pvals = adj_pvals,
    mnk = mnk,
    sim = sim
  )
}

## -----------------------------
## 5. Bootstrap stability
## -----------------------------
.jaccard <- function(a, b) {
  u <- sum(a | b)
  if (u == 0) return(NA_real_)
  sum(a & b) / u
}

.poisson_calls_once <- function(Z_sub, Y_sub, X_sub, W, size_factor,
                                fdr_thresh = 0.05) {
  mnk <- compute_mnk(Z_sub, Y_sub, W)

  K <- ncol(mnk)
  pvals <- numeric(K)
  for (k in seq_len(K)) {
    fit <- suppressWarnings(
      glm(mnk[, k] ~ X_sub + offset(log(size_factor)),
          family = quasipoisson())
    )
    pvals[k] <- summary(fit)$coefficients[2, 4]
  }

  adjp <- p.adjust(pvals, method = "fdr")
  disc <- adjp < fdr_thresh
  names(disc) <- colnames(mnk)
  disc
}

stability_for_dataset_poisson <- function(sim, B = 50, fdr_thresh = 0.05, seed = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)

  Z <- as.matrix(sim$Z)
  Y <- as.matrix(sim$Y)
  X <- sim$X
  W <- as.matrix(sim$W)
  lib_size <- as.numeric(sim$library_size)

  K <- ncol(Z)
  disc_mat <- matrix(FALSE, nrow = B, ncol = K)
  colnames(disc_mat) <- paste0("Topic", seq_len(K))

  for (b in seq_len(B)) {
    idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(Z)), replace = TRUE)
    disc_mat[b, ] <- .poisson_calls_once(
      Z_sub = Z[idx, , drop = FALSE],
      Y_sub = Y[idx, , drop = FALSE],
      X_sub = X[idx],
      W = W,
      size_factor = lib_size[idx],
      fdr_thresh = fdr_thresh
    )
  }

  topic_freq <- colMeans(disc_mat)

  if (B >= 2) {
    pair_ids <- combn(B, 2)
    jacc_vals <- apply(pair_ids, 2, function(ix) {
      .jaccard(disc_mat[ix[1], ], disc_mat[ix[2], ])
    })
    mean_jacc <- mean(jacc_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    mean_jacc <- NA_real_
  }

  list(
    topic_freq = topic_freq,
    mean_jacc = mean_jacc,
    disc_mat = disc_mat
  )
}

## -----------------------------
## 6. Signal scenario
## -----------------------------
set.seed(999)

R <- 100
power_vec    <- numeric(R)
fdr_vec      <- numeric(R)
stab_jaccvec <- numeric(R)
stab_avgfreq <- numeric(R)

for (r in seq_len(R)) {
  out <- run_one_sim_poisson(
    N = 2000,
    G = 300,
    K = 6,
    frac_diff = 0.4,
    beta_strength = 2,
    seed = r
  )

  m <- compute_metrics(out$disc, out$true_topics)
  power_vec[r] <- m$power
  fdr_vec[r]   <- m$emp_fdr

  stab <- stability_for_dataset_poisson(out$sim, B = 50, fdr_thresh = 0.05)
  stab_jaccvec[r] <- stab$mean_jacc
  stab_avgfreq[r] <- mean(stab$topic_freq)
}

cat("=== Quasipoisson : SIGNAL scenario ===\n")
cat("Mean power across sims          =", round(mean(power_vec, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
cat("Mean empirical FDR across sims  =", round(mean(fdr_vec), 3), "\n")
cat("Mean Jaccard stability          =", round(mean(stab_jaccvec, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
cat("Mean topic discovery frequency  =", round(mean(stab_avgfreq, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")

## -----------------------------
## 7. Single-run stability example
## -----------------------------
set.seed(123)

out <- run_one_sim_poisson(
  N = 2000,
  G = 300,
  K = 6,
  frac_diff = 0.4,
  beta_strength = 2,
  seed = 123
)

m <- compute_metrics(out$disc, out$true_topics)
stab <- stability_for_dataset_poisson(out$sim, B = 50, fdr_thresh = 0.05)

cat("\n=== Quasipoisson : single run ===\n")
cat("Power =", round(m$power, 3), "\n")
cat("Empirical FDR =", round(m$emp_fdr, 3), "\n")
cat("Mean Jaccard stability =", round(stab$mean_jacc, 3), "\n")

topic_summary <- data.frame(
  Topic = paste0("Topic", seq_along(stab$topic_freq)),
  TrueDiff = out$true_topics,
  DiscoveryFreq = round(stab$topic_freq, 3)
)
print(topic_summary, row.names = FALSE)

## -----------------------------
## 8. Null scenario
## -----------------------------
set.seed(999)

null_fdr <- numeric(R)
pvals_by_topic <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = R, ncol = 6)
adjp_by_topic  <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = R, ncol = 6)

for (r in seq_len(R)) {
  out <- run_one_sim_poisson(
    N = 2000,
    G = 300,
    K = 6,
    frac_diff = 0.0,
    beta_strength = 2,
    seed = r
  )

  m <- compute_metrics(out$disc, out$true_topics)
  null_fdr[r] <- m$emp_fdr
  pvals_by_topic[r, ] <- out$pvals
  adjp_by_topic[r, ]  <- out$adj_pvals
}

cat("=== Quasipoisson : NULL scenario ===\n")
cat("Mean empirical FDR across sims =", round(mean(null_fdr), 3), "\n")

par(mfrow = c(2, 3))
for (k in 1:6) {
  hist(pvals_by_topic[, k],
       breaks = 20, col = "skyblue", border = "white",
       main = paste("Topic", k), xlab = "Raw p-value", ylab = "Frequency")
  abline(h = R / 20, col = "red", lty = 2)
}
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

par(mfrow = c(2, 3))
for (k in 1:6) {
  hist(adjp_by_topic[, k],
       breaks = 20, col = "skyblue", border = "white",
       main = paste("Topic", k), xlab = "Adjusted p-value", ylab = "Frequency")
  abline(h = R / 20, col = "red", lty = 2)
}
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```
